reason: I already do one big shop a week at Spinneys or Tawfeer and fill the boot, so a daily list on WhatsApp doesn't fit how I buy. I'd still have to go and collect it at their hour, not mine.
objection: I finish work at 6 in Jounieh and the drive home eats into the 6 to 8 window, so I'd be rushing to a pickup point for a bag I could have bought myself on my weekly trip. Also I'd be trusting strangers to pick my brands and tell me the real till price.
would_change_my_mind: Home delivery, or a pickup window that runs later, plus a receipt photo for every order so I can see the real prices.
